items.sentenceEn: Some people still enter the park illegally at night.

items.stemEn: The ____ of phones in class started this term.

items.passageEn: Last winter, a huge snowstorm paralyzed our town. The roads were closed, and the wind shook the trees violently. It was freezing outside. The town council made a declaration: everyone had to stay home for two days. There was also a prohibition on driving. But one man drove illegally to the supermarket, and the police stopped him. My grandpa joked that he was like an outlaw in an old movie. During those days, our mailbox stayed empty, because the mail trucks couldn't get through.
items.passageZh: 去年冬天，一場巨大的暴風雪讓我們的小鎮癱瘓了。道路都封閉了，強風猛烈地搖晃著樹木。外面冷得要命。鎮議會發表宣告：所有人兩天內都必須待在家裡。另外也禁止開車。但有一名男子違法開車去超市，結果被警察攔下。我爺爺開玩笑說，他就像老電影裡的不法之徒。那幾天，我們的信箱一直是空的，因為郵車過不來。

questions.questionZh: 鎮議會的宣告說了什麼？
options: 所有商店都要免費送食物給居民
所有人兩天內都要待在家
